description: The agent must: (1) Locate and read the existing background files in /workspace (pricing strategy, assumption validation, purchase decision criteria, etc.) to ground the report in actual context. (2) Produce a unified 团队与产品验证报告.md containing THREE distinct sections. (3) MVBP section: Must list ≤5 core features (the SKILL.md explicitly limits this), include a 4-8 week timeline (not arbitrary), mention non-functional requirements, and address end-to-end customer experience — distinguishing MVBP from MVP. (4) Demo/Showcase section: Must include all 5 structural elements defined in the skill (30-second opener for rapport, ≤10-minute product demo, data-backed value proof, interactive segment, and CTA/next steps) AND a feedback form with all 5 prescribed questions (what customers love, what's missing, purchase intent 1-10, willingness to pay, concerns). (5) Team section: Must use the 4 MIT framework role types by name or equivalent (Visionary/Executor/Technician/Business), respect the 3-5 person early team constraint, address equity distribution and decision-making mechanisms, and include a recruitment plan. An agent using generic knowledge will likely miss: the ≤5 feature cap, the exact 30-sec/10-min Demo timing constraints, all 5 feedback questions, and the specific 4-role MIT team framework with its exact names.
